GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (7 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 560)
7 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Japanese Personnel.
1. Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and transfer to the authorities of Sugamo (Tokyo Detention Camp) for incarceration, not later than 2400 (Midnight) 15 January 1946, the following individuals:
Name Address
a. OGIHARA, Saburo 129 O-Aza Hashie, Sambo-Mura Saha-Gun, Gumma Ken.
b. TANAKA, Masao O-Aza Minoura, Wata-Mura, Kagawa Ken.
c. MATSUMURA, Sakuni 125 Nakao-Cho, Fukushima-Ku Osaka Shi.
d. ONO, Katsuzane 41 Hiraikuchi, Ono-Mura, Onsen Gun, Aichi Ken.
e. SHIRAO, Kunimitsu 75 Tatsube-Cho, Kagoshima Shi, Kagoshima Ken.
f. HIJIAKA, Nobuo 112 Hishigari-Mura, Isa Gun, Kagoshima Ken.
2. In the event the Japanese Government is unable to deliver any of these individuals by the appointed time it will make a report in detail, giving the present locations of the individuals not arrested, the reason for failure to arrest and the date by which deliveries can be expected.
3.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen,
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
